title: Calendar has zero memoization anywhere, so it fully reconciles on every unrelated Settings keystroke while still mounted behind the overlay
where: index.html:3883 (Calendar), :3942 (MonthSection), :4706 (Your-name input) & :4714 (differential-rename input), :3560-3571 & :3630-3631 (mount structure — Settings is a sibling overlay, calendar stays mounted underneath), :2189/:2203/:2214 (name/differentials useState in App), :4016-4036 (NumInput — the existing local-buffer fix pattern one field over, not applied to the name field)
detail: Confirmed via `grep -n "React.memo\|memo("` returning zero hits anywhere in the file — MonthSection/Calendar have no memo boundary at all. `monthWindow` (index.html:2663-2670, MONTH_BEFORE=3/MONTH_AFTER=12) keeps 16 <MonthSection> instances mounted simultaneously (up to ~500-670 `.cell` buttons via the Calendar loop). The Settings sheet is rendered as a sibling overlay (`{showSettings && <Settings .../>}` at :3630), not a replacement — the calendar JSX above it stays mounted and visible underneath the `.scrim`, confirmed by the shared `document.body.style.overflow` effect (:2596-2600), which only toggles a CSS property and never unmounts anything. Two Settings fields write directly to App-level state on every keystroke (not buffered like NumInput, which only commits on blur/Enter): the "Your name" field (`onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value||'there')}`, :4706) and the differential rename field (`onChange={e=>upd(k,'name',e.target.value)}` -> `setDiff(...)`, :4714). Both `name` and `differentials` are declared with `useState` at the top of `function App(){`. Because `keyOf`/`statOf`/`onPick` etc. are also freshly created arrow functions on every App render and no child is memoized, every keystroke while renaming a shift differential or editing the display name forces React to re-run the Calendar cell-generation loop for all 16 preloaded months and reconcile every button element's className/aria-label/glyph markup — work that has nothing to do with what's on screen (Settings, not the calendar) and nothing to do with what changed.
failure: On an older/lower-powered iPhone, typing a full name (8-10 keystrokes) or renaming "Night" to "Nights" in Settings visibly stutters/lags per character, because React fully reconciles ~450-670 off-screen calendar day cells (each calling statOf) across 16 months — even though the calendar isn't even visible while this happens (hidden behind the Settings scrim). Gets worse as logged shift history grows.
fix: Wrap MonthSection (and/or Calendar) in React.memo with useCallback-stabilized keyOf/statOf/onPick, or at minimum unmount/hide the calendar tree while an overlay sheet is open (e.g. gate the `.dash` block on `!showSettings && !sheetDate && ...` the same way the body-scroll-lock effect already tracks those flags). As an immediate, low-risk fix for the name field specifically, buffer it locally the same way NumInput already does one line below it (index.html:4016-4036: local state, commit on blur/Enter) instead of calling setName on every keystroke.
